top_signals.title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Joel Weber puts Scarlet Fu, Eric Balchunas, and Isabelle Lee to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Airtel Money Is Said to Trim IPO Size Ahead of Deal Kickoff
top_signals.summary: Airtel Money’s owners are considering raising less money than previously sought in the company’s initial public offering, a listing process that could start as soon as next week, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
